items.source: Create a new resource handler registry for the given application context.
items.translation: 为给定的应用程序上下文创建一个新的资源处理器注册表。
servletContext - 相应的 Servlet 上下文

items.source: Then use additional methods on the returned ResourceHandlerRegistration to add one or more locations from which to serve static content from (for example, {"/", "classpath:/META-INF/public-web-resources/"}) or to specify a cache period for served resources.
items.translation: 然后使用返回的ResourceHandlerRegistration上的附加方法，添加一个或多个用于提供静态内容的路径（例如，{"/", "classpath:/META-INF/public-web-resources/"}），或指定已提供资源的缓存期限。

items.source: Patterns such as "/static/**" or "/css/{filename:\\w+\\.css}" are supported.
items.translation: 支持诸如 `"/static/**"` 或 `"/css/{filename:\\w+\\.css}"` 之类的模式。

items.source: A variant of ResourceHandlerRegistry(ApplicationContext, ServletContext, ContentNegotiationManager) that also accepts the UrlPathHelper used for mapping requests to static resources.
items.translation: 一种变体，除了接受 `(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext,jakarta.servlet.ServletContext,org.springframework.web.accept.ContentNegotiationManager)` 之外，还接受用于将请求映射到静态资源的 UrlPathHelper。

items.source: Specify the order to use for resource handling relative to other HandlerMappings configured in the Spring MVC application context.
items.translation: 指定相对于在 Spring MVC 应用程序上下文中配置的其它HandlerMappings的资源处理顺序。

items.source: Return a handler mapping with the mapped resource handlers; or null in case of no registrations.
items.translation: 返回包含已映射资源处理器的处理器映射；若无注册，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Whether a resource handler has already been registered for the given path pattern.
items.translation: 给定路径模式是否已注册了资源处理器。

items.source: contentNegotiationManager - the content negotiation manager to use
items.translation: contentNegotiationManager - 要使用的内容协商管理器

items.source: For pattern syntax see PathPattern when parsed patterns are enabled or AntPathMatcher otherwise. The syntax is largely the same with PathPattern more tailored for web usage and more efficient.
items.translation: 有关模式语法，请参阅 PathPattern（当解析的模式已启用时），否则请参阅 AntPathMatcher。语法大体相同，但 PathPattern 更适用于 Web 使用场景且效率更高。

items.source: To create a resource handler, use addResourceHandler(String...) providing the URL path patterns for which the handler should be invoked to serve static resources (for example, "/resources/**").
items.translation: 要创建资源处理器，请使用addResourceHandler(String...)提供应调用该处理器以提供静态资源的 URL 路径模式（例如，"/resources/**"）。

items.source: Add a resource handler to serve static resources.
items.translation: 添加资源处理器以提供静态资源。
